Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The urine results show significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, hematuria, nitrites, bacteria, and >100,000 CFU/mL Proteus mirabilis, indicating a urinary tract infection, likely complicated. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy; further evaluation for possible upper urinary tract involvement is advised.
